lines: 1 cup raisins, chpd dates or figs

steps: Beat until soft. ½ c butter
Add sugar gradually. Blend these ingredients until they are very light and creamy.
Beat in one at a time; 2 eggs
Sift before measuring: 1½ c bread flour
Resift with ½ teas soda, 1 teas cinnamon, ½ teas cloves, ¼ teas alspice, ⅛ teas salt
Add the sifted ingredients in 3 parts to the butter mixture alternately with thirds of ¼ c water.
Beat the batter til it's smooth after each addition.
Stir: 1 cup broken nut meats, 1 cup raisins, chpd dates or figs
Drop batter from a teas. onto a greased tin.
Bake cookies in a moderate oven 375 for about 12 min.
